cards.name: Ceiling Cat
cards.caption: Ceiling Cat is watching u
cards.flavor: Lolcat scripture, 2007: a cat peeks through a hole in the ceiling and judges you.
cards.art: White cat head and two front paws poking down through a jagged round hole in a beige drop ceiling, wide curious eyes, tiny pink nose. Background: simple ceiling-tile grid. Colors: white, beige, pink, charcoal outline.

cards.name: Keyboard Kitty
cards.caption: Play him off
cards.flavor: 2009's ultimate closer: a cat in a shirt plays every fail video off the stage.
cards.art: Gray tabby cat in a red-and-white striped T-shirt, paws on a chunky retro synth keyboard, deadpan half-lidded stare, music notes floating up. Background: flat teal with a stage-curtain edge. Colors: gray, red, white, teal.

cards.name: Y U NO Yeti
cards.caption: Y U NO PULL LEGENDARY
cards.flavor: Rage comics, 2010: arms up, mouth wide, grammar optional. Y U NO?
cards.art: Shaggy white yeti with both arms thrown up in exasperation, huge oval screaming mouth, simple black-line rage-comic eyes. Background: white comic panel with a thick black border. Colors: white, ice blue, black.

cards.name: Planking Plank
cards.caption: Born to plank
cards.flavor: 2011's least athletic sport: lie face-down, stiff as a board, somewhere weird.
cards.art: A wooden plank with a tiny smug face lying perfectly stiff across the top of a fridge, arms glued to its sides. Background: flat kitchen wall with a simple window. Colors: warm wood brown, white, teal, black outline.

cards.name: Dramatic Prairie Dog
cards.caption: DUN DUN DUNNNN
cards.flavor: 2007's five-second epic: a 'chipmunk' (it's a prairie dog) turns and stares.
cards.art: Tan prairie dog snapping its head toward the viewer, eyes huge and intense, three motion lines by its head, dramatic purple spotlight cone. Background: near-black. Colors: tan, purple, black, white.

cards.name: Longcat
cards.caption: Longcat is looooong
cards.flavor: Imageboard legend, 2007: a white cat held up so long it never seems to end.
cards.art: An absurdly tall, skinny white cat stretched vertically across the whole card, front paws dangling at the top, back paws at the bottom, sleepy content face. Background: sky blue with tiny clouds for scale. Colors: white, pink, sky blue.

cards.name: Knee Arrow Guard
cards.caption: Took an arrow to the knee
cards.flavor: 2011: every town guard 'used to be an adventurer like you.' Then... ouch.
cards.art: Chunky cartoon town guard in a round helmet and plain tabard sitting on a crate, sheepishly pointing at a cartoon arrow stuck in his bandaged knee. Background: gray stone wall. Colors: steel gray, red, tan, brown.

cards.name: Philosoraptor
cards.caption: Are we the memes now?
cards.flavor: 2008 advice animal: a velociraptor stroking its chin over unanswerable questions.
cards.art: Green velociraptor with one claw on its chin, eyes rolled up in deep thought, a single thought bubble with a question mark. Background: flat mustard yellow. Colors: lime green, mustard, cream, black.

cards.name: Gallop Style Pony
cards.caption: Oppa gallop style!
cards.flavor: 2012: the first video to hit 1 billion YouTube views had the whole planet horse-dancing.
cards.art: Chubby brown pony in tiny black sunglasses and a blue tux jacket doing the invisible-rider dance: knees bent, one hoof circling an imaginary lasso. Background: disco floor tiles and spotlights. Colors: brown, royal blue, gold, black.

cards.name: Problem Goblin
cards.caption: Problem?
cards.flavor: Trollface era, 2008: the grin behind every prank, bait link and 'u mad?'
cards.art: Lanky green goblin face with an enormous wraparound grin of square teeth, scrunched mischievous eyes, raised brows, hands rubbing together. Background: dark charcoal. Colors: goblin green, white, black, charcoal.

cards.name: Nyam Cat
cards.caption: Nyam nyam nyam nyam nyam
cards.flavor: 2011's 10-hour loop: a snack-bodied cat zooming through space on a rainbow.
cards.art: Chunky pixel-style gray cat whose body is a square golden waffle with syrup dots, flying right, six-stripe rainbow trail behind, twinkling stars. Background: navy space. Colors: waffle gold, gray, rainbow stripes, navy.

cards.name: Rickroll Bun
cards.caption: Never gonna give you up
cards.flavor: Since 2007 every link might be a trap. This bread roll in a trench coat? Also a trap.
cards.art: Round golden bread roll with a tall swoopy pompadour, wearing a beige trench coat, doing an awkward side-step dance with fists pumping. Background: hyperlink blue with a giant mouse cursor. Colors: golden brown, beige, link blue, black.
